sloka: तानि च आस्वाद्य तेजस्वी फलानि इति स्म मन्यते ।अनास्वादित पूर्वाणि वने नित्य निवासिनाम् ॥१-१०-२१॥
transliteration: tāni ca āsvādya tejasvī phalāni iti sma manyate ।anāsvādita pūrvāṇi vane nitya nivāsinām ॥1-10-21॥

translations.english: The lustrous (Rsyasringa) who had never tasted any food other than what was offered by the permanent forestdwellers mistook them for fruits.
